notes: Raw dumpsys batterystats -c output including checkin aggregates and history. Captured via adb exec-out so line endings are preserved. The development emulator was exercised with dumpsys batterystats --history-create-events 100 and its battery level was driven from 100 down to 50, so the history includes generated events and level-drop summaries. This is a development-emulator state, not a pristine boot capture.
